text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Big Bang Idol Fest. Hokko 
Tarumae debuts her new song—one filled 
with precious memories of Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through song, she conveyed what Tomakomai 
meant to her, and what she meant to 
Tomakomai. Touched to their core, the 
audience began to take an interest in 
Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she didn't reach the summit of 
local idols, her song resonated with Smart 
Falcon. Perhaps, in that small way, she 
was able to repay her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae was producing results as 
both a local idol and a racer. Eager to 
catch up to her, Copano Rickey threw down 
a challenge!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae rises to the challenge. But 
first comes the JBC Classic! A rematch 
with Wonder Acute awaits!
